brief: Rhythmic pulses of red and black expand rapidly across a black void, leaving persistent trails of light residue that fade slowly. When the mouse is clicked, new pulses spawn at that exact location and drift outward with varying speeds. Dragging the cursor scatters these lingering lights into chaotic patterns while maintaining the core rhythmic pulse rate. The visuals evolve continuously through time, creating a hypnotic dance of expanding rings and fading echoes against the dark background without any external audio or 3D rendering requirements.

statement: This sketch creates a mesmerizing visual experience of rhythmic pulses expanding from random points. The black canvas serves as a void where red and black pulses rapidly expand outward, leaving glowing trails that fade slowly behind them. Each pulse is a glowing ring that grows at its own speed, creating an organic, chaotic dance across the screen. The system accumulates these lingering lights into a persistent layer of luminous residue that slowly dissipates over time. The viewer's interaction with the mouse adds new pulses and scatters existing lights, creating a constantly evolving pattern of motion. The visual rhythm is maintained by the consistent timing of pulse expansion, while the fading trails create an impression of temporal depth and continuity.
